shortDescription: Resource module for Backup Schedule Config Update

options.name: backupDescription
options.description: Description of the backup.

options.name: backupEncryptionKey
options.description: The encyption key for the backed up file. Encryption key must satisfy the following criteria - Contains at least one uppercase letter A-Z, Contains at least one lowercase letter a-z, Contains at least one digit 0-9, Contain only A-Za-z0-9_#, Has at least 8 characters, Has not more than 15 characters, Must not contain 'CcIiSsCco', Must not begin with.

options.name: backupName
options.description: The backup file will get saved with this name.

options.name: endDate
options.description: End date of the scheduled backup job. Allowed format MM/DD/YYYY. End date is not required in case of ONE_TIME frequency.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Backup Schedule Config Update's frequency.

options.name: ise_debug
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: ise_hostname
options.description: The Identity Services Engine hostname.

options.name: ise_password
options.description: The Identity Services Engine password to authenticate.

options.name: ise_single_request_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for RESTful HTTP requests.

options.name: ise_username
options.description: The Identity Services Engine username to authenticate.

options.name: ise_uses_api_gateway
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether to use the Identity Services Engine's API Gateway to send requests. If it is true, it uses the ISE's API Gateway and sends requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}. If it is false, it sends the requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}:{{port}}, where the port value depends on the Service used (ERS, Mnt, UI, PxGrid).

options.name: ise_uses_csrf_token
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether we send the CSRF token to ISE's ERS APIs. If it is True, the SDK assumes that your ISE CSRF Check is enabled. If it is True, it assumes you need the SDK to manage the CSRF token automatically for you.

options.name: ise_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: ise_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Identity Services Engine to use.

options.name: ise_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable automatic rate-limit handling.

options.name: monthDay
options.description: Day of month you want backup to be performed on when scheduled frequency is MONTHLY. Allowed values - from 1 to 28.

options.name: repositoryName
options.description: Name of the configured repository where the generated backup file will get copied.

options.name: startDate
options.description: Start date for scheduling the backup job. Allowed format MM/DD/YYYY.

options.name: status
options.description: Backup Schedule Config Update's status.

options.name: time
options.description: Time at which backup job get scheduled. Example- 12 00 AM.

options.name: weekDay
options.description: Backup Schedule Config Update's weekDay.
